testcase.system-out: Scenario: Navigate backward and forward through template folders ✔> Given a fresh MCAD Software session loads `fixtures/cad/document-creation-native-candidate.opj` as its active project ✔> And the native catalog contains metric and inch templates in their respective folders ✔> And the catalog root has no direct template files ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the user presses Control+N to open the new-document template chooser ✔ And the new-document template chooser is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the selected template folder is not the English folder ✔ When the user selects the English template folder ✔ And the user selects the metric template folder ✔ And the user chooses Back in the chooser navigation bar ✔ Then the English folder is selected ✔ And the gallery displays its inch templates ✔ When the user chooses Forward in the chooser navigation bar ✔ Then the metric folder is selected ✔ And the gallery displays its metric templates
